bottleneck_link: The selected complex side binds. The P104 exact decoder has a favorable 5.438% packing-ceiling margin over the selected fixed-word ceiling, but existing delivery bounds require at least 47 added copies for the pinned decoder. A support-changing basis shear could lower that physical delivery tax; the charge model allows at most 21 additional rank-one local children while retaining the catalogue's 5% acceptance margin.
stop_rule: Completed one evidence-driven pivot. The first 392 shears used all 56 ordered term pairs and lambda in {−2,−1,−1/2,1/2,1,2,3}; all had cst=58. The second screen covered all 71,344 two-shear paths whose successive ordered term pairs share at least one index, with that same seven-value alphabet at both steps. All 336 cst=56 paths are exact inverse moves on the same ordered pair, and there are no cst=57 paths. Exact dynamic programming over all eight-term rank profiles in 0..9 shows cst=57 has minimum moment above 1 at the 5% target; higher cst is strictly worse. Stop this route after the finite screen; a longer product of shears is a separate task.

Exact touching two-shear screen: 71,344 paths have cst histogram {56:336,58:2744,59:32928,60:35336}; every cst=56 path is the identity factorization obtained by inverse shears on the same ordered pair. At target a, the most favorable rank profiles (allowing one zero term) have moment lower bounds 1.0001233630 at cst=57 and 1.0002720827 at cst=58, so every nontrivial path in the bounded domain fails the 5% gate before delivery, restoration, hosting or precision costs are added.
